 Reality TV show host Chris Harrison previews his new dating show 'The Vow' on Fox Nation.
 NEW You can now listen to Fox News articles!
 Chris Harrison is making his return to reality TV on Fox Nation's first original dating show, "The Vow."
 Harrison will host "The Vow" and serve as an executive producer alongside his wife, Lauren Zima.
 The first two episodes premiere Nov. 11 on Fox Nation, followed by weekly Wednesday releases through the Dec. 9 season finale.
 You can watch the first episode for free on YouTube and other streaming and social sites.
 Below is everything to know about the upcoming dating series, "The Vow."
 CHRIS HARRISON RETURNS TO REALITY TV WITH 'THE VOW,' FOX NATION'S FIRST-EVER DATING SHOW 
 What is 'The Vow'?
 "The Vow" will follow 30-year-old Jace Cates as he navigates relationships with 10 women seeking lasting commitment and marriage over six episodes.
 Unlike dating shows built around fleeting connections and social media attention, "The Vow" will put long-term commitment at the center of the experience. Through a series of decisions and honest conversations, Cates and the women will tackle questions surrounding faith, family, communication and their plans for the future — all with the goal of determining whether a relationship has what it takes to lead to marriage.
 "We were inspired by the faith-driven renaissance happening across America, and as a result, I believe we’ve created the most authentic dating show on television today," Harrison said.
 He continued, "At a time when so many people feel dating has become harder than ever , 'The Vow' asks a simple but important question: Can genuine, lasting love still be found in the modern world? The stakes couldn’t be higher. I’m incredibly proud and honored to put my name on this show."
 Who are the women?
 "The Vow" features 10 women. 
 Jace Cates is the 30-year-old season lead on the Fox Nation dating series, "The Vow." (Fox Nation) 
 The 10 women include Kylee, a 28-year-old from Charlotte, North Carolina.
 WATCH ‘THE VOW’ ON FOX NATION 
 Chris Harrison will host "The Vow" on Fox Nation. (Denise Truscello/Getty Images) 
 Joining her are Alexis, Audrey, Haleigh, Julia, Kierstin, Marley, MJ, Mya and Sierra. 
 The women range in age from 25 to 33, according to Fox Nation's cast introduction videos.
 How does the show work?
 Cates "embarks on a relationship journey with ten women, each seeking lasting commitment and marriage."

 "The Vow" examines "the real-life questions that shape successful marriages while encouraging contestants to leave the process if they no longer believe the relationship has a genuine future."
 Chris Harrison's "The Vow" will begin streaming on Fox Nation on Nov. 11. (Fox Nation)
